name: Gas turbine and combined-cycle installed cost benchmarks 2021–2026 (government, benchmark and analyst figures)
description: Dated $/kW evidence for simple-cycle turbines and combined-cycle plants. The same technology carries materially different figures depending on dollar year, plant size, output basis (ISO/net) and whether financing is included. All figures preserved in the currency and basis stated by the page.
